title: Museum of the Future receives more than 20,000 applications for “Future Perfects” in just 48 hours
summary: Campaign website records 42,000 visits as Dubai's unconventional talent search gains momentum, with applications open until 8 November 2026 on futureperfects.ae

contentHtml:
Museum of the Future. Image Courtesy: Dubai Future Foundation

Campaign website records 42,000 visits as Dubai's unconventional talent search gains momentum, with applications open until 8 November 2026 on futureperfects.ae

Press Release

  • The Museum's recruitment team begins reviewing applications to identify candidates with the human qualities needed to lead its reimagined visitor experience.
  • Future Perfects introduces a world-first job title that prioritises imagination, emotional intelligence and adaptability over conventional career backgrounds.

Dubai, UAE: Within just 48 hours of launching its search for the world's first “Future Perfects”, Dubai's Museum of the Future has received more than 20,000 completed applications, while the campaign's official website has recorded 42,000 visits, reflecting strong early interest in its unconventional approach to discovering talent.

Launched on 21 October, the initiative seeks individuals who will become the human face of the Museum's completely reimagined visitor experience when it reopens in 2027. Unlike conventional recruitment processes, the search places imagination, curiosity, emotional intelligence, warmth and adaptability at the centre of how candidates are assessed, with no previous museum or customer-service experience required.

Azza AlNuaimi, COO of the Museum of the Future, said: "The response in the first 48 hours reflects strong interest in career opportunities that recognise human potential beyond what is written on a CV. Dubai has always believed in recognising potential beyond conventional paths, and Future Perfects brings that belief into practice. We believe that what makes someone uniquely human could be exactly what makes them a Future Perfect. Shaping the future requires more than knowledge alone; it requires the ability to make that knowledge meaningful and accessible to others."

The Museum's recruitment team has begun reviewing applications, with candidates set to progress through assessments, shortlisting and final live auditions before an expert judging panel. Successful applicants will join the Museum's Visitor Experience team in full-time roles, helping visitors connect with ideas about science, technology, nature, society and the future through meaningful human interactions.

Applications remain open until 8 November 2026 through the official portal, Futureperfects.ae, giving more individuals the opportunity to demonstrate the qualities that could make them a Future Perfect.
